description: Return every outcome that the frames, roadmaps, NOICE rankings, and Opportunity Solution Trees of a Space hold, one row per outcome. Each row lists the documents that hold it, with the outcome id in that document and what that builder says about it (a roadmap column and status, a NOICE rank, the progress of a frame goal). A row with a linkId is one outcome by a stored link. A row without one groups outcomes only because their titles are the same. Each row also lists the story maps, ROI calculations, and Wardley maps attached to the outcome; a story map that holds the stories for one roadmap bet names the bet. `suggestions` lists pairs of rows with different titles that share words and are not linked: they may be one outcome, so ask the reader before you link them. The result also lines up the workflow stages and the people that the documents name, by name only. Use it to find an outcome that one document holds and another does not, and for the ids that spaces_link_outcomes and spaces_copy_outcome take.
name: spaces_list_outcomes
title: List the outcomes of a Space across its documents
